claim: Resolver DNS Firewall charges for DNS queries originating from within VPCs that have firewall rule group associations (and for queries through inbound Resolver endpoints into them) and a fee for each domain name stored in a domain list, with no domain name fee for managed domain lists. Rule groups that contain DNS Firewall Advanced rules add an hourly fee for each rule group, per VPC association in an AWS Region.

evidence.quote: We charge for DNS queries originating from within VPCs that have firewall rule group associations and DNS queries traversing inbound Resolver endpoints from on-premises networks into VPCs that have firewall rule group associations.
We charge a fee for each domain name stored in a domain list within a rule group. No fees are charged for domain names within managed domain lists.
We charge an hourly fee for each DNS Firewall rule group which contains one or more DNS Firewall Advanced rules, per VPC association in an AWS Region.

When using managed domain lists within your DNS Firewall Foundation rules, you are not charged for the domain names fee above, but you are charged for the DNS queries that are inspected against the rules which use managed domain lists.
